items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: You know a guy that called Ike Play Trombone? He lives on Claymore Street.

ctx.x: He died in the 20s. Now what did Chris Kelly look like in the dress?
You know a guy that called Ike Play Trombone? He lives on Claymore Street. Don't you know a fellow called Ike?
Around Domain? That's right, yeah. I don't know. I heard about it.
